actions.action: Verify that 'Your Morning Ritual' card is visible on the home screen.
Tap on the 'Your Morning Ritual' card to open the ritual details.
Verify that 'Wake Up' is the first step in the ritual list.
Tap the checkmark next to 'Wake Up' to mark it as completed.
Verify that the progress indicator at the top updates to reflect 1 completed step.
Tap the checkmark next to 'Hydrate' to complete the next step.
Tap the back button to return to the main rituals list.
